MODAL.TITLE: Whatsapp Templates
MODAL.SUBTITLE: Select the whatsapp template you want to send

PARSER.FORM_ERROR_MESSAGE: Please fill all variables before sending
PARSER.MEDIA_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Name the customer will see (e.g. Invoice A1.pdf)
PARSER.TEMPLATE_FILE: The template's file will be sent:

ERRORS.BODY: Fill in all the body variables.
ERRORS.MEDIA_URL: Enter the public link to the file (must start with http:// or https://).
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_LENGTH: The copy code can have up to %{max} characters.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.NEW_DESC: Build the message, check the preview and send it to Meta for review. If you don't finish it, save it as a draft.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.DRAFT_DESC: This is a draft: it hasn't reached Meta yet. You can change everything except the inbox.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.EDIT_DESC: Meta only lets you change the category and the content; name, language and inbox stay fixed. Saving sends the template back to review.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.NAME_HINT: Formatted automatically: lowercase, no spaces or accents. It can't change once it reaches Meta.
FIELDS.OR_LINK: …or paste a public link to the file (https://…)
FIELDS.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the message. Use variables like %{variable} for data that changes on each send.
FIELDS.EXAMPLES: Variable examples: Meta reviews them and they show in the preview.
FIELDS.FOOTER_PLACEHOLDER: Short footer, no variables (e.g. your company name)
FIELDS.NO_VARIABLES: The message has no variables. Type %{variable} in the text to add one.

CATEGORY_HINTS.UTILITY: Updates about something the customer already asked for: payments, appointments, orders, shipping.
CATEGORY_HINTS.MARKETING: Promotions, offers and invitations. Meta reviews and charges them differently from utility ones.
CATEGORY_HINTS.AUTHENTICATION: Verification codes: they have a fixed format and are created in Meta's WhatsApp Manager.

LIMITS.IMAGE: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB

BUTTONS.EMPTY: No buttons (they're optional). Add one with the buttons above.
BUTTONS.URL_DYNAMIC_HINT: When sending the template you type the end of the link (e.g. the order number).
BUTTONS.PHONE_HINT: Type the full number with the country code (+1…).
BUTTONS.CODE_HINT: The real code is typed when sending the template; this one is only for Meta's review.

PREVIEW.CAPTION: This is how the customer will see it in WhatsApp.

ALERTS.SUBMITTED: Template sent to Meta for review.
ALERTS.RESUBMITTED: Changes sent: the template goes back to review.
ALERTS.WRONG_TYPE: That file doesn't work for this header. Accepted: %{allowed}.

READY.TITLE: Ready for Meta
READY.ALL_GOOD: All good: you can send it for review.

LEAVE.TITLE: Leave without saving?
LEAVE.DESCRIPTION: You have unsaved changes in this template. If you leave now, they'll be lost.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_EDITOR.NAME_TAKEN: Name: there's already a template with that name and language in this inbox

VARIABLES.MANUAL: Typed by the agent when sending

REJECTIONS.ABUSIVE_CONTENT: Meta considered it abusive content. Review the text and remove anything that may sound aggressive or misleading.
REJECTIONS.INCORRECT_CATEGORY: The category doesn't match the content. If it offers or invites to buy, it's Marketing; if it updates on something the customer already asked for, it's Utility.
REJECTIONS.INVALID_FORMAT: The format is invalid: check the variables (no gaps, not at the start or end), the examples and that the text has no odd characters.
REJECTIONS.PROMOTIONAL: It has promotional content in a non-Marketing category. Change it to Marketing or remove the promotion.
REJECTIONS.SCAM: Meta considered it a possible scam. Avoid asking for sensitive data or payments in a suspicious way.
REJECTIONS.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The content doesn't match the chosen category. Change the category or adjust the text.
REJECTIONS.OTHER: Check the reason in WhatsApp Manager, fix it with “Edit” and send it again.

SEND.TITLE: Can be sent
SEND.NOT_YET: It can be sent once Meta approves it.
SEND.TRACKINGS_MISSING_FILE: Follow-ups and campaigns: the file is missing (Edit)
SEND.TRACKINGS_NO: Not in follow-ups and campaigns (this inbox doesn't allow it)
SEND.TRACKINGS_NEEDS_DATA: Not in follow-ups and campaigns: it needs header or button data they can't fill

ACTIONS.EDIT_LOCKED: It can't be edited while Meta reviews it or in its current status.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_LIST.EMPTY: No templates to show. Create one or sync from Meta.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.TITLE: Delete “%{name}”
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.DRAFT: It's a draft: it never reached Meta, so it's only deleted here.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.IN_META: It's also deleted in Meta (this language only), and Meta won't let you reuse that name for 30 days.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.USAGE_FAILED: We couldn't check where this template is used: some sends may depend on it.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.WILL_FAIL: If you delete it, those sends will fail. Change the template there first.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_DELETE.ACKNOWLEDGE: I understand those sends may fail until the template is changed.
